result.citation_basis: § 151.09: O088 (also O030, O034); 'Rent Stabilization Ordinance' as the chapter's own title: O088 (Chapter XV heading), O033 (§ 151.00)
result.official_quote: A landlord may bring an action to recover possession of a rental unit only upon one of the following grounds: The landlord shall file with the Department any such written notice terminating a tenancy within three business days of service on the tenant.
result.note: Changed to the standard 'L.A. Mun. Code' form at section level because the card merges the eviction grounds (A), filing (C.9) and relocation (G) subsections, and dropped § 165.05(B)(5), which is the Just Cause Ordinance provision for non-RSO units rather than the RSO rule on this card.
